key_insight: Bayesian optimization shows a clear trade-off: rigid nozzles maximize thrust-like impulse, while flexible nozzles deliver better energy efficiency in pulsed-jet propulsion.
engineering_relevance: This provides a design guide for aquatic robots and propulsion devices by matching nozzle compliance to whether peak force or efficiency is the priority.
method: 3D fluid-structure interaction simulations of pulsed-jet flow
Multi-objective Bayesian optimization over rigid and flexible nozzle geometries
Comparison of impulse and jet-energy metrics across optimized designs
evidence_signal: The abstract reports up to 5× impulse amplification for rigid nozzles and about 1.8× higher normalized impulse-to-energy ratio for flexible nozzles relative to rigid designs.
watch_item: Results are simulation-based, so real-world fabrication, material durability, and flow-condition sensitivity may affect how well the optimized geometries transfer to hardware.
paper_title: Multi-objective Bayesian optimization of rigid and flexible nozzles for energy-efficient pulsed jet propulsion
